FROM studios
WHERE whatsapp_instance = '{{ $json.instance }}'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
SELECT phone, push_name, intent, step, data, history, updated_at
FROM bot_sessions
WHERE studio_id = {{ $json.studio_id }} AND phone = '{{ $('Normalizar mensagem').first().json.phone }}'
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO bot_sessions (studio_id, phone, push_name, intent, step, data, history, updated_at)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.studioId }},
  '{{ $json.phone }}',
  '{{ $json.pushName }}',
  '{{ $json.intent }}',
  '{{ $json.step }}',
  '{{ $json.sessionData }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.history }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (studio_id, phone) DO UPDATE SET
  push_name = EXCLUDED.push_name,
  intent = EXCLUDED.intent,
  step = EXCLUDED.step,
  data = EXCLUDED.data,
  history = EXCLUDED.history,
  updated_at = NOW();
